description: Progress of a keyword scan (scan_id from spywin_queue_keyword_scan / spywin_list_my_scans: per keyword queued, running, done, failed or expired — not picked up by the app within 15 minutes — and ads found) or of a Page / store / ad scan (request_id from spywin_queue_page_scan). Includes the app status. When a keyword scan is done, read the videos with spywin_get_scan_results; when a Page / store / ad scan is done, call its lookup tool again.
name: spywin_get_scan_status
title: Status of my keyword scan
